I'm working out that the pipeline's component labels don't match the schematic's, so I need to go by the pipeline's IDs and the real connections instead. Next I'm matching each pipeline component to its position in the annotation image, starting with M5 at the top-left.

Now I'm checking the pipeline's M5 against the schematic: it's a PMOS with its source at VDD, its drain on net5, and its gate tied to ground, so it matches the original M19. M10 also looks like a PMOS with its gate on ground and its drain on net7, which I'll take as the original M20. The M6 and M13 entries seem to line up with the original M10 and M11 positions too.

I'm now going through the rest of the pipeline-to-original mapping by position, since the GND label seems to be merged across several nets and I can't trust it at face value.

Next I'm matching the remaining pipeline IDs to their original positions: M8 is orig M4, M11 is orig M5, and M12 is orig M6, which drains into net8 as Vref.

Now I'm assigning the rest of the pipeline IDs to their original positions: M14 sits in the bottom-row slot of orig M14 with its source on net9, and M16 maps to orig M15 with its drain on net9. M15 and M17 likewise take the orig M12 and M13 spots, and M19 through M23 get their matches from the lower-left block.

Now I'm checking the remaining mappings, placing the pipeline's R and Q labels against their original positions. Q2 sits where orig Q1 is, Q1 matches orig Q3, and Q3 matches orig Q2, with Q4 unchanged. I still can't read the netlist cleanly because the GND label is merged across many nets, so I'll work out the true connectivity separately before comparing.

I'm checking the gate net that ties M1, M2, M3, M7 and M10 together, and tracing it down to the M5 drain. I'm also noting that the left-hand gate line runs down toward M22's drain.

I'm checking the gate lines in the second row, which tie M11, M9, M8, M4, M5 and M6 together, and noting that the M9 gate node also runs down toward the M17 drain. Next I'm working out which nets the pipeline has wrong, since it currently shows every gate as GND, so I'll need to rebuild the connectivity before making any edits.

I'm now setting up the true netlist using the pipeline's IDs, so I can compare it against the original. The sources on the top-row PMOS devices are labeled GND in the pipeline, which makes me suspect the GND net has merged supply and ground together, so I'll need to sort out VDD on its own.

Now I'm working through the wire paths around the M23 gate and the nodes near M14 and M12, tracing where each one lands. Since the pipeline's GND label is merged across too many nets, I'll decide on a set of pin edits in the pipeline's own terms rather than trying to read every connection off the drawing.

Now I'm laying out the true connections using the original labels: the top-row PMOS sources all go to VDD, and the second row's sources are each tied to a drain from the row above, with M9's source going straight to VDD.

Checking the pipeline's M5 and M10 connections, it looks like the source labeled GND may really be VDD, so I'm going to verify that before changing any pin assignments.

Checking the remaining pipeline nets against the original: M4's drain feeds M11's source, M6's drain feeds M13's source, and M1's drain feeds M8's source. M3's drain is next.

I'm checking whether the first-level connections hold up: M5's drain should match M10's source, and the top-row sources all seem to be labeled GND. That label could be hiding VDD, since the rail is just a bare line marked VDD, so I'll need to confirm which net the sources really sit on.

Now I'm working out how to set the pins in the pipeline's own terms, since the GND label looks merged with the supply and gate nets.

I'm weighing whether to just name the supply net "VDD" and rewire the source pins that currently point at GND, since that's a lot of edits to get right.

I'm going back over the drain connections on the top row, and I think the M12 drain runs up to the same node as M5's drain, which is the gate net I'm tracing.

Now I'm grouping the row-two gates, which tie together M11, M9, M8, M4, M5 and M6, and the M21 drain runs up to that same gate net.

Checking the drain of M17 now: its line runs up to the node at (395,215), which is the same net as M9's drain.

Checking whether M11's drain runs down the same x=305 line to M18, since that would tie it into the rest of the gate network.

I'm tracing the net through M11's drain, which runs down the x=305 line to a node that also feeds M18's drain and gate, so M18 looks diode-connected with M11 stacked above it. That same node carries on right to the M14 and M12 gates around y=273.

I'm tracing the connections around M4 and M14 now. The node at (612,258) ties M4's drain to M14's drain, and that same node runs to the gates of M23, M15 and M13, so I'm grouping those together as one net.

Checking whether the y=273 wire crosses the x=612 and x=690 verticals, since the pipeline reported no crossings and may have merged those nets. Next I'm tracing where the orig M14 source and the M15 drain connect.

Now I'm tracing the remaining connections around M22, M21, and M23: M22's gate and M21's gate look tied together at the shared node, with M21's source going to ground, and M23's source also going to ground.

Now I'm mapping the pipeline's M1, M2 and M3 onto their original counterparts, with gates on the shared G1 net and sources tied to VDD.

Now I'm assigning the remaining pipeline pins: M4, M6 and M5 are wired as before, with M5's gate correctly on ground, and M7, M8, M9, M10, M11 and M12 are being mapped onto their original counterparts.

Now I'm mapping the remaining pipeline pins onto the original netlist: M13's gate goes to G2 and its drain to L, M14's drain is H with its gate on L, and M15 and M16 each get their drains and gates reassigned. The last two entries are the ones that differ most: the pipeline's M20 and M18 both have wrong drains and gates, and I need to correct them to L, G2 and net7.

Now I'm settling the remaining pins: M19 takes its drain from G1 with its gate on net7, M21's gate goes to H, and M22 and M23 get their drains and gates reassigned to the nb and G2 nets. I'm also noting the resistor R1 runs from net8 to net11.

Q4's base needs to be ground, and the bottom-left Q's emitters are where the reasoning is at. I'm weighing whether the top-row sources labeled GND might actually be VDD, since the pipeline may have merged the two rails, so I'll keep the ground-connected pins as they are and assign the supply pins to VDD.

Now I'm assigning the net names for the pins: the supply-side sources go to VDD, and the gates and drains tied to the G1 and G2 nets get reassigned to match.

Now I'm finishing the pin assignments: the gate and drain nets for M9, M11, M12, M13, M18 and M23 are set, and the H, L and nb groups are gathered. Ground is already right on M22's source, and M5 and M10's gates are correct as they stand. I'll write out the JSON.
